declarations.explanation: The confirmed documentation targets already follow the v0.12.0 documentation guidance, because this repository authored that release; no edit was needed. The two documentation roots, docs and factory/docs, each have a root README index and usage, development and adr categories with README indexes, every document is listed in exactly one index, the root development guide has its purpose, Setup and validation section and index, and both glossaries plus GLOSSARY-MAP.md stay outside docs. The root usage index purpose is one sentence and uses no glossary term.
evidence: docs/README.md, docs/usage/README.md, docs/development/README.md and docs/adr/README.md index every document under docs; factory/docs/README.md and its usage, development and adr indexes cover the factory documentation tree.
docs/development/README.md starts with its purpose, then Setup and validation, then its Documents index.
GLOSSARY-MAP.md lists GLOSSARY.md and factory/GLOSSARY.md as the Repo Canon and Factory contexts.
Superseded ADRs such as docs/adr/0004 and docs/adr/0011 are kept and marked superseded, naming their superseding ADRs.

declarations.explanation: .factory/Dockerfile installs only the toolchain on a Debian-based Node.js 24 image: it starts from node:24-bookworm, which provides Node.js 24 and npm, and installs the Repository Standards CLI 6.0.0 globally with RUN from the npm registry. It adds no agent tooling, user, ENTRYPOINT or CMD, needs no build context, and leaves npm ci to the run. v0.12.0's Node.js 24 requirement is therefore already met and the file is unchanged.
evidence: docs/development/README.md Setup and validation names Node.js 24 and npm, and public Repository Standards CLI 6.0.0 for source validation; Git and the GitHub CLI come from the factory's layer.
.agents/skills/babysit/SKILL.md runs wait.mjs and merge.mjs with node, which node:24-bookworm provides at major 24.

Sandbox image run 38447194749 built this identical file (git diff ff875c8..HEAD -- .factory/Dockerfile is empty) on a GitHub-hosted runner from docker.io/library/node:24-bookworm and wrote the image successfully.
node --version was not run inside the built image here, because no Docker daemon is available locally; the base image tag fixes Node.js at major 24.
